en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘You can free the camel inside the Al-Harram to eat whatever it so desires to’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad from Hariz who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Camels can be left in al-Haram (the sacred area) to eat whatever it likes.’”
